parts.text: As of 1 June 2026 the Alderbridge Flexible Working Policy applies to every employee from day one and explicitly covers requests for compressed hours (for example four longer days instead of five). An employee should submit a written flexible working request (including the proposed start date); the manager will consider it within one month (or agree an extension), and where practical a start date and any trial period are agreed in writing so the change can be tested before being confirmed permanently. A worked example in the policy shows a care worker moving to four longer days via an agreed eight-week trial with review of cover and continuity before confirming the change.
